title: P1 maker/post-only economics — preregistered BEFORE its data exists (descriptive, NOT a strategy)
author_lane: independent 4th agent (owner-directed); filed to manager for review
role: P1 is the only PIVOT-01 family never measurable for $0 — it needs L2/book data. This preregistration is frozen BEFORE any qualifying capture exists (purest possible freeze: the data does not exist yet). It creates NO strategy, NO candidate, consumes NO attempt budget. After the 10-day capture lands, this document governs the measurement; no parameter may change after first data contact.

data_requirement_frozen.source: owner-run self-capture per coord/pivot/CAPTURE-RUNBOOK.md (pilot cap-pilot-1h started 2026-10-16 by this lane to measure bytes/hour) or Tardis Solo (owner purchase decision)
data_requirement_frozen.floor: >=10 days untouched tick, per symbol: L2 book (depth snapshot+diff, synced per the repo's depth protocol) + aggTrades + marks >=1s + funding settlements + monotonic seq — identical to the PIVOT-01 enrollment floor
data_requirement_frozen.symbols: the pilot's pinned pair (expected BTCUSDT+ETHUSDT; continuity rule per runbook section 2)
data_requirement_frozen.absent_data_rule: if the capture does not complete or fails audit, verdict is DATA BLOCKED — never scored on partial windows for decision purposes

hypothesis_frozen: Post-only maker orders on BTC/ETH USDT-perps earn the quoted spread net of adverse selection and maker fees; the edge is queue position plus a short-horizon toxicity filter, not directional prediction.

fill_model_frozen.why_bracket: Queue position is unobservable in public data; any single fill model is an assumption. The honest measurement brackets the truth with two declared bounds — no fitted queue model, no parameter tuning.
fill_model_frozen.optimistic_join: a resting post-only order at the best bid (buy) fills when any trade prints at price <= order price (trade-through-or-touch fills you; zero queue ahead assumed)
fill_model_frozen.conservative_through: the order fills only when a trade prints STRICTLY THROUGH the order price (price < order price for buy; full queue ahead assumed)
fill_model_frozen.truth_statement: realized fill rate and adverse selection lie between the bounds; both are reported, decisions use BOTH

quote_policy_frozen.side: always BOTH sides quoted (join best bid and best ask, post-only, one order per side per symbol)
quote_policy_frozen.requote: re-quote when the best price moves away from the order by >= 1 tick; cancel-and-rejoin
quote_policy_frozen.toxicity_filter_declared: cancel the quoted side when trailing-10s trade flow against that side exceeds buy_frac >= 0.6 (or <= 0.4 for the bid side); re-quote after 5s calm. Threshold declared a priori from the S5 flow convention (0.58 arm gate), not fitted.
quote_policy_frozen.inventory_rule: flat-biased: any filled inventory is exited at touch (taker) after 60s or when the opposite side fills (spread captured round-trip); no directional carry

economics_frozen.captured_spread: for a buy fill at p with mid m at fill time: (m - p); round-trip capture = sell-leg touch fill minus taker fee
economics_frozen.fees: Binance USDT-M VIP0 maker 2.0 bps, taker 5.0 bps (list; BNB -10% labeled post-hoc)
economics_frozen.markouts: mark-price move vs fill side at +5s, +30s, +60s, +300s (adverse selection measure; negative = toxic flow)
economics_frozen.funding: settled funding over any inventory hold, attributed signed

decision_rules_frozen.family_kill_inherited: adverse markout at fill+5s worse than -spread/2 on average, OR realized spread capture < 0 after fees (PIVOT-01 P1 kill criteria, unchanged)
decision_rules_frozen.merits_candidate: >= 200 maker fill events across the window AND optimistic-model mean net capture >= +0.5 bp/order AND conservative-model mean net capture >= -2.0 bp/order AND fill+5s markout >= -spread/2 — all three models' conditions must hold
decision_rules_frozen.else: P1 NOT-MERITED on this data; the 10-day capture question closes with a measured answer either way
decision_rules_frozen.no_candidate_creation: a MERITS-CANDIDATE verdict goes to the owner as a decision, never auto-advances; any candidate config is a separate preregistration

posthoc_sensitivity_declared: toxicity threshold {0.55, 0.65}; requote tick {1, 2}; inventory exit {30s, 120s} — all labeled POST-HOC, never decision-relevant
non_goals: No strategy/spec/code changes in any worker lane
No credentials, no orders, live submission stays disabled
No claim of profitability; the capture pilot measures bytes/hour only
